signature_moved_out_of_scope.reason: SignedInfo names prefix foo in InclusiveNamespaces, but foo is declared on the Assertion. Moving the Signature out of the Assertion changes the inherited context, so the SignedInfo canonical bytes differ from what was signed.

tampered_default_namespace_dropped.reason: Dropping #default removes the inherited default namespace from the canonical form; the digest must fail.

tampered_reference_prefix_added.reason: Adding an InclusiveNamespaces parameter to the Reference changes the digest input; the original digest must not verify.

tampered_reference_prefix_removed.reason: Removing the Reference InclusiveNamespaces drops xmlns:foo from the canonical form; the digest no longer matches.

tampered_signed_info_prefix_changed.reason: Changing the SignedInfo prefix list changes SignedInfo canonical bytes, so the RSA signature must fail.
